note: *Behold I die... the Elohim of your ancestors will visit you, and bring you back to the land, which Yahuah sware to give to you* (Jasher 56:3) — the dying charge of 48:21 kept whole, fixed on the covenant land.

quotes.quote: Behold I die... the Elohim of your ancestors will visit you, and bring you back to the land, which Yahuah sware to give to you
quotes.live_here: And Jacob said to Joseph and to his sons, Behold I die, and the Elohim (God) of your ancestors will visit you, and bring you back to the land, which Yahuah (the Lord) sware to give to you and to your children after you, now therefore when I am dead, bury me in the cave which is in Machpelah in Hebron in the land of Canaan, near my ancestors.

note: *bring you out of Egypt and bring you back to the land of your fathers to inherit it securely* (Jasher 56:21) — the deathbed hope of 48:21 looking through the bondage to the deliverer and the inheritance.

quotes.quote: bring you out of Egypt and bring you back to the land of your fathers to inherit it securely
quotes.live_here: And it shall come to pass when you shall go after Elohim to serve him and will teach your children after you, and your children’s children, to know Yahuah (the Lord), then will Yahuah (the Lord) raise up to you and your children a servant from amongst your children, and Yahuah (the Lord) will deliver you through his hand from all affliction, and bring you out of Egypt and bring you back to the land of your fathers to inherit it securely.

note: *reign over them, and your sons shall reign over their sons forever* (Jasher 56:8) — Jacob speaks the scepter to Judah's face; the kingship of 49:10 fixed forever.

quotes.quote: reign over them, and your sons shall reign over their sons forever
quotes.live_here: And Jacob said to Judah, I know my son that you are a mighty man for your brethren; reign over them, and your sons shall reign over their sons forever.

note: *Yahuah will raise up to you and your children a servant... and deliver you... from all affliction* (Jasher 56:21) — Jacob's death-bed hope (49:18) rests on the Deliverer Yahuah promised to raise.

quotes.quote: Yahuah will raise up to you and your children a servant... and deliver you... from all affliction
quotes.live_here: And it shall come to pass when you shall go after Elohim to serve him and will teach your children after you, and your children’s children, to know Yahuah (the Lord), then will Yahuah (the Lord) raise up to you and your children a servant from amongst your children, and Yahuah (the Lord) will deliver you through his hand from all affliction, and bring you out of Egypt and bring you back to the land of your fathers to inherit it securely.

note: *many and grievous troubles will befall you in the latter days... only serve Yahuah and he will save you* (Jasher 56:20) — the latter-days word of 49:1 met by the charge to serve Yahuah.

quotes.quote: many and grievous troubles will befall you in the latter days... only serve Yahuah and he will save you
quotes.live_here: For I know that many and grievous troubles will befall you in the latter days in the land, yea your children and children’s children, only serve Yahuah (the Lord) and he will save you from all trouble.

note: *forgive I pray you... for Elohim intended it for your and your children's benefit* (Jasher 56:17) — Jacob's dying charge carries the very theology of 50:20: the injury bent to blessing.

quotes.quote: forgive I pray you... for Elohim intended it for your and your children's benefit
quotes.live_here: And you, Joseph my son, forgive I pray you the prongs of your brethren and all their misdeeds in the injury that they heaped upon you, for Elohim intended it for your and your children’s benefit.

note: *the Elohim of your ancestors will visit you, and bring you back to the land, which Yahuah sware* (Jasher 56:3) — Jacob's dying words mirror Joseph's 50:24; father and son in one faith.

quotes.quote: the Elohim of your ancestors will visit you, and bring you back to the land, which Yahuah sware
quotes.live_here: And Jacob said to Joseph and to his sons, Behold I die, and the Elohim (God) of your ancestors will visit you, and bring you back to the land, which Yahuah (the Lord) sware to give to you and to your children after you, now therefore when I am dead, bury me in the cave which is in Machpelah in Hebron in the land of Canaan, near my ancestors.

note: *Jacob was buried in Hebron, in the cave of Machpelah which Abraham had bought... for the possession of a burial place* (Jasher 56:66) — the same grave of 50:13; the oath to bury him in Canaan kept.

quotes.quote: Jacob was buried in Hebron, in the cave of Machpelah which Abraham had bought... for the possession of a burial place
quotes.live_here: And Jacob was buried in Hebron, in the cave of Machpelah which Abraham had bought from the sons of Heth for the possession of a burial place, and he was buried in very costly garments.

note: Jasher 79:27 — *Pharaoh sent for Balaam the magician and to Jannes and Jambres his sons, and to all the magicians* the Hebrew library names the very pair Paul names; the named magicians summoned against Moses (2 Timothy 3:8).

quotes.quote: Pharaoh sent for Balaam the magician and to Jannes and Jambres his sons, and to all the magicians
quotes.live_here: And when they had gone Pharaoh sent for Balaam the magician and to Jannes and Jambres his sons, and to all the magicians and conjurors and counsellors which belonged to the king, and they all came and sat before the king.

note: Jasher 1:1 — *And Elohim (God) said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness, and Elohim created man in his own image.* The antediluvian chronicle itself — the life of Adam and Eve recounted from the forming — is the kind of record Eve commands her children to engrave and preserve.

quotes.quote: And Elohim (God) said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness, and Elohim created man in his own image.
quotes.live_here: And Elohim (God) said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness, and Elohim created man in his own image.

note: *Yahuah (the Lord) appeared there to him in the bush... the fire had no power over the bush to consume it* (Jasher 79:3) — the sight of 3:2 kept whole in the restored witness; the Formed One in the unconsuming flame.

quotes.quote: Yahuah (the Lord) appeared there to him in the bush... the fire had no power over the bush to consume it
quotes.live_here: And when he came to Horeb, Yahuah (the Lord) appeared there to him in the bush, and he found the bush burning with fire, but the fire had no power over the bush to consume it.

note: *Yahuah (the Lord) called to Moses out of the fire and commanded him to go down to Egypt* (Jasher 79:4) — the call from the flame of 3:4: the One in the fire speaks and sends him to deliver.

quotes.quote: Yahuah (the Lord) called to Moses out of the fire and commanded him to go down to Egypt
quotes.live_here: And Moses was greatly astonished at this sight, therefore the bush was not consumed, and he approached to see this mighty thing, and Yahuah (the Lord) called to Moses out of the fire and commanded him to go down to Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to send the children of Israel from his service.

note: *when I see your Passover, I will pass over you* (Jasher 80:41) — the promise of *Yahuah (LORD) will pass over the door* (12:23) in Yahuah's own voice: the smiting and the passing-over in one night.

quotes.quote: when I see your Passover, I will pass over you
quotes.live_here: And the days of darkness passed away, and Yahuah (the Lord) sent Moses and Aaron to the children of Israel, saying, Celebrate your feast and make your Passover, for behold I come in the midst of the night amongst all the Egyptians, and I will smite all their first born, from the first born of a man to the first born of a beast, and when I see your Passover, I will pass over you.

note: *Also a mixed multitude went up with them, and flocks and herds, even much cattle* (Jasher 81:2) — the going-out of *a mixed multitude went up also with them* (12:38); the joined ones brought out with the covenant-people, who come in by ONE Torah (12:48-49).

quotes.quote: Also a mixed multitude went up with them, and flocks and herds, even much cattle
quotes.live_here: Also a mixed multitude went up with them, and flocks and herds, even much cattle.

note: *Fear not, stand still and see the salvation of Yahuah (the Lord) which He will effect this day for you* (Jasher 81:28) — Moses' charge of 14:13 carried verse-for-verse in the restored witness.

quotes.quote: Fear not, stand still and see the salvation of Yahuah (the Lord) which He will effect this day for you
quotes.live_here: And Moses said to them, Fear not, stand still and see the salvation of Yahuah (the Lord) which He will effect this day for you.

note: *Yahuah (the Lord) will fight for you, and you shall remain silent* (Jasher 81:32) — word-for-word with *Yahuah shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace* (14:14).

quotes.quote: Yahuah (the Lord) will fight for you, and you shall remain silent
quotes.live_here: And Moses said to them, Stand in your places, for Yahuah (the Lord) will fight for you, and you shall remain silent.

note: *the waters of the sea were divided into twelve parts, and the children of Israel passed through on foot... as a man would pass through a prepared road* (Jasher 81:38) — the *dry ground* of 14:22 opened for the twelve tribes.

quotes.quote: the waters of the sea were divided into twelve parts, and the children of Israel passed through on foot... as a man would pass through a prepared road
quotes.live_here: And the waters of the sea were divided into twelve parts, and the children of Israel passed through on foot, with shoes, as a man would pass through a prepared road.

note: *they beheld the great hand of Yahuah (the Lord), in what he had performed in Egypt and in the sea* (Jasher 81:42) — the beholding of the great work of 14:30-31, the ground of the faith that followed.

quotes.quote: they beheld the great hand of Yahuah (the Lord), in what he had performed in Egypt and in the sea
quotes.live_here: And on that day Yahuah (the Lord) saved Israel from the hand of Egypt, and all the children of Israel saw that the Egyptians had perished, and they beheld the great hand of Yahuah (the Lord), in what he had performed in Egypt and in the sea.

note: *Yahuah (the Lord) caused food to rain from heaven for the children of Israel day by day* (Jasher 81:48) — the daily bread of *I will rain bread from heaven for you* (16:4) kept verse-for-verse in the restored witness.

quotes.quote: Yahuah (the Lord) caused food to rain from heaven for the children of Israel day by day
quotes.live_here: At that time Yahuah (the Lord) gave the manna to the children of Israel to eat, and Yahuah (the Lord) caused food to rain from heaven for the children of Israel day by day.

note: *Amalek the son of Eliphaz, the son of Esau... came to fight with Israel* (Jasher 81:52) — the foe of 17:8 traced to Esau's line: the old enmity within the family of promise.

quotes.quote: Amalek the son of Eliphaz, the son of Esau... came to fight with Israel
quotes.live_here: And when the children of Israel were in Rephidim, Amalek the son of Eliphaz, the son of Esau, the brother of Zepho, came to fight with Israel.

note: *the children of Israel smote Amalek and his people at the edge of the sword, but the battle was very sore* (Jasher 81:55) — the victory of 17:13 kept entire; the seed-war won at cost.

quotes.quote: the children of Israel smote Amalek and his people at the edge of the sword, but the battle was very sore
quotes.live_here: And the children of Israel smote Amalek and his people at the edge of the sword, but the battle was very sore upon the children of Israel.

note: *Write this thing as a memorial for you in a book, and place it in the hand of Joshua... efface the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven* (Jasher 81:56) — the command of 17:14 set down verse-for-verse in the restored witness.

quotes.quote: Write this thing as a memorial for you in a book, and place it in the hand of Joshua... efface the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven
quotes.live_here: And Yahuah (the Lord) said to Moses, Write this thing as a memorial for you in a book, and place it in the hand of Joshua, the son of Nun, your servant, and you shall command the children of Israel, saying, When you shall come to the land of Canaan, you shall utterly efface the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven.

note: *when Yahuah your Elohim shall have given you rest from all your enemies... you shall blot out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven, you shall not forget it* (Jasher 81:60) — the perpetual war of 17:16 bound to the day of rest in the inheritance.

quotes.quote: when Yahuah your Elohim shall have given you rest from all your enemies... you shall blot out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven, you shall not forget it
quotes.live_here: Therefore it shall be when Yahuah your Elohim (the Lord your God) shall have given you rest from all your enemies round about in the land which Yahuah your Elohim gives you for an inheritance, to possess it, that you shall blot out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven, you shall not forget it.

note: *Moses... brought up from there the coffin of Joseph and took it with him* (Jasher 80:62) — the extended witness keeps the deed of 13:19: Moses sees to the oath on the night of the going-out.

quotes.quote: Moses... brought up from there the coffin of Joseph and took it with him
quotes.live_here: And Moses hastened and rose up and went to the river of Egypt, and brought up from there the coffin of Joseph and took it with him.

note: *the glory of Yahuah (the Lord) rested upon Mount Sinai... Moses came in the midst of a cloud* (Jasher 82:8) — the resting Glory of *altogether on a smoke, because Yahuah descended upon it in fire* (19:18).

quotes.quote: the glory of Yahuah (the Lord) rested upon Mount Sinai... Moses came in the midst of a cloud
quotes.live_here: And the glory of Yahuah (the Lord) rested upon Mount Sinai, and he called to Moses, and Moses came in the midst of a cloud and ascended the mountain.

note: *Yahuah (the Lord) gave to Israel the ten commandments on Mount Sinai* (Jasher 82:6) — the gift of the descent of *Yahuah came down upon mount Sinai* (19:20): the ten words of the holy nation.

quotes.quote: Yahuah (the Lord) gave to Israel the ten commandments on Mount Sinai
quotes.live_here: And in the third month from the children of Israel’s departure from Egypt, on the sixth day of it, Yahuah (the Lord) gave to Israel the ten commandments on Mount Sinai.

note: *the glory of Yahuah (the Lord) rested upon Mount Sinai, and he called to Moses, and Moses came in the midst of a cloud* (Jasher 82:8) — the glory, the call, the cloud of 24:16; Moses enters the Formed presence.

quotes.quote: the glory of Yahuah (the Lord) rested upon Mount Sinai, and he called to Moses, and Moses came in the midst of a cloud
quotes.live_here: And the glory of Yahuah (the Lord) rested upon Mount Sinai, and he called to Moses, and Moses came in the midst of a cloud and ascended the mountain.

note: *Moses was upon the mount forty days and forty nights... Yahuah (the Lord) instructed him in the statutes and judgments in order to teach the children of Israel* (Jasher 82:9) — the forty days of 24:18, the Torah given to teach (as 24:12).

quotes.quote: Moses was upon the mount forty days and forty nights... Yahuah (the Lord) instructed him in the statutes and judgments in order to teach the children of Israel
quotes.live_here: And Moses was upon the mount forty days and forty nights; he ate no bread and drank no water, and Yahuah (the Lord) instructed him in the statutes and judgments in order to teach the children of Israel.

note: *hew two stone tablets... and Yahuah wrote the ten commandments upon the tablets* (Jasher 82:24) — the restored witness keeps the renewal of 34:1 verse-for-verse.

quotes.quote: hew two stone tablets... and Yahuah wrote the ten commandments upon the tablets
quotes.live_here: Then spoke Yahuah (the Lord) to Moses to hew two stone tablets and to bring them up to Yahuah (the Lord), who would write upon them the ten commandments.

note: *Yahuah (the Lord) wrote the ten commandments upon the tablets* (Jasher 82:25) — matches *the words of the covenant, the ten commandments* (34:28); the same ten words on the second tables.

quotes.quote: Yahuah (the Lord) wrote the ten commandments upon the tablets
quotes.live_here: Now Moses did so, and he came down and hewed the two tablets and went up to Mount Sinai to Yahuah (the Lord), and Yahuah (the Lord) wrote the ten commandments upon the tablets.

note: *make a sanctuary for Yahuah (the Lord), that his name might rest in it* (Jasher 82:27) — the extended witness gives the command of 25:8; the Name resting in the midst is the Presence dwelling.

quotes.quote: make a sanctuary for Yahuah (the Lord), that his name might rest in it
quotes.live_here: And Yahuah (the Lord) commanded him respecting the children of Israel that they should make a sanctuary for Yahuah (the Lord), that his name might rest in it, and Yahuah (the Lord) showed him the likeness of the sanctuary and the likeness of all its vessels.

note: *Yahuah (the Lord) showed him the likeness of the sanctuary and the likeness of all its vessels* (Jasher 82:27) — the extended witness keeps the showing of *which was shewed thee in the mount* (25:40).

quotes.quote: Yahuah (the Lord) showed him the likeness of the sanctuary and the likeness of all its vessels
quotes.live_here: And Yahuah (the Lord) commanded him respecting the children of Israel that they should make a sanctuary for Yahuah (the Lord), that his name might rest in it, and Yahuah (the Lord) showed him the likeness of the sanctuary and the likeness of all its vessels.

note: *he ordered them to bring him gold and he made it into a molten calf for the people* (Jasher 82:14) — the restored witness keeps the fashioning of 32:4; the calf came of Aaron's yielding to the crowd.

quotes.quote: he ordered them to bring him gold and he made it into a molten calf for the people
quotes.live_here: And Aaron was greatly afraid of the people, and he ordered them to bring him gold and he made it into a molten calf for the people.

note: *Get you down, for your people... have corrupted themselves* (Jasher 82:15) — the word of 32:7 kept verse-for-verse in the restored witness.

quotes.quote: Get you down, for your people... have corrupted themselves
quotes.live_here: And Yahuah (the Lord) said to Moses, before he had come down from the mount, Get you down, for your people whom you did bring forth from Egypt have corrupted themselves.

note: *now therefore leave me, that I may consume them... for they are a stiffnecked people* (Jasher 82:16) — the wrath of 32:10; the "leave me" / "let me alone" is the hinge on which Moses' intercession turns.

quotes.quote: now therefore leave me, that I may consume them... for they are a stiffnecked people
quotes.live_here: They have made to themselves a molten calf, and have bowed down to it, now therefore leave me, that I may consume them from off the earth, for they are a stiffnecked people.

note: *Moses besought the countenance of Yahuah (the Lord), and he prayed to Yahuah for the people on account of the calf* (Jasher 82:17) — the intercession of 32:11 in the restored witness; the mediator pleads at once for the calf-makers.

quotes.quote: Moses besought the countenance of Yahuah (the Lord), and he prayed to Yahuah for the people on account of the calf
quotes.live_here: And Moses besought the countenance of Yahuah (the Lord), and he prayed to Yahuah (the Lord) for the people on account of the calf which they had made, and he afterward descended from the mount and in his hands were the two tablets of stone, which Elohim had given him to command the Israelites.

note: *Yahuah (the Lord) hearkened to the prayer of Moses, and Yahuah was entreated of him in behalf of Israel* (Jasher 82:23) — the turning of *Yahuah repented of the evil* (32:14); the wrath turned away by the mediator's entreaty.

quotes.quote: Yahuah (the Lord) hearkened to the prayer of Moses, and Yahuah was entreated of him in behalf of Israel
quotes.live_here: And during the forty days did Moses entreat Yahuah (the Lord) in behalf of the children of Israel, and Yahuah (the Lord) hearkened to the prayer of Moses, and Yahuah (the Lord) was entreated of him in behalf of Israel.

note: *I will go up to Yahuah (the Lord), peradventure I may make atonement for your sins* (Jasher 82:21) — the mediator's resolve of *peradventure I shall make an atonement* (32:30) in the restored witness; Moses climbs the mount to atone, not to accuse.

quotes.quote: I will go up to Yahuah (the Lord), peradventure I may make atonement for your sins
quotes.live_here: And on the morrow Moses said to the people, I will go up to Yahuah (the Lord), peradventure I may make atonement for your sins which you have sinned to Yahuah (the Lord).

note: *She took for him an ark of bulrushes, and daubed it with slime and with pitch, and put the child in it, and she laid it in the flags by the river's brink* (Jasher 68:13) — a near word-for-word second witness to Exodus 2:3 (the tebah, Noah's very word).

quotes.quote: She took for him an ark of bulrushes, and daubed it with slime and with pitch, and put the child in it, and she laid it in the flags by the river's brink
quotes.live_here: And the woman hastened to take away her son before the officers came, and she took for him an ark of bulrushes, and daubed it with slime and with pitch, and put the child in it, and she laid it in the flags by the river’s brink.

note: *Yahuah (the Lord) brought forth the children of Israel from Egypt with a strong hand* (Jasher 81:4) — the seven "I will" become recorded history, the bringing-out accomplished.

quotes.quote: Yahuah (the Lord) brought forth the children of Israel from Egypt with a strong hand
quotes.live_here: And at the end of two hundred and ten years, Yahuah (the Lord) brought forth the children of Israel from Egypt with a strong hand.

note: Jasher 81:43 — *Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song to Yahuah*, the same hour the Egyptians fell.

quotes.quote: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song to Yahuah
quotes.live_here: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song to Yahuah (the Lord), on the day when Yahuah (the Lord) caused the Egyptians to fall before them.

note: Jasher 81:44 — *all Israel sang in concert... I will sing to Yahuah*; Miriam's refrain as the whole congregation answering.

quotes.quote: all Israel sang in concert... I will sing to Yahuah
quotes.live_here: And all Israel sang in concert, saying, I will sing to Yahuah (the Lord) for He is greatly exalted, the horse and his rider has he cast into the sea; behold it is written in the book of the law of Elohim.

note: *The serpent of Aaron's rod... opened its mouth to swallow the rods of the magicians* (Jasher 79:38) — the witness that names Jannes & Jambres (79:27) shows the swallowing in full.

quotes.quote: The serpent of Aaron's rod... opened its mouth to swallow the rods of the magicians
quotes.live_here: And the serpent of Aaron’s rod lifted up its head and opened its mouth to swallow the rods of the magicians.

note: *The rod of Aaron swallowed up their rods* (Jasher 79:42) — tested on the magicians' own terms, the true rod still devours the counterfeit.

quotes.quote: The rod of Aaron swallowed up their rods
quotes.live_here: And when they were restored to rods, the rod of Aaron swallowed up their rods.

note: *Turned all the waters of Egypt into blood, with all their streams and rivers* (Jasher 80:3) — the witness confirms the totality of the plague.

quotes.quote: Turned all the waters of Egypt into blood, with all their streams and rivers
quotes.live_here: And Yahuah (the Lord) sent by the hand of Aaron and turned all the waters of Egypt into blood, with all their streams and rivers.

note: *the bones of their first born... were raked up by the dogs of Egypt on that night* (Jasher 80:46) — the dogs loud over Egypt's dead, silent against Yashar'el.

quotes.quote: the bones of their first born... were raked up by the dogs of Egypt on that night
quotes.live_here: Even the bones of their first born who had died before this and whom they had buried in their houses, were raked up by the dogs of Egypt on that night and dragged before the Egyptians and cast before them.

note: *according to the oath of Yahuah (the Lord) between him and our Father Abraham* (Jasher 80:59) — the riches bound straight to the Abrahamic oath that guaranteed them.

quotes.quote: according to the oath of Yahuah (the Lord) between him and our Father Abraham
quotes.live_here: And all the Egyptians sent the Israelites forth, with great riches, sheep and oxen and precious things, according to the oath of Yahuah (the Lord) between him and our Father Abraham.

note: *Behold I have not found the name of your Elohim written in this book, and his name I know not* (Jasher 79:44) — the restored scene: Pharaoh ransacks Egypt's royal chronicles for the Name and finds nothing, for Yahuah is no idol catalogued among the dead gods.

quotes.quote: Behold I have not found the name of your Elohim written in this book, and his name I know not
quotes.live_here: And Pharaoh said to Moses and Aaron, Behold I have not found the name of your Elohim written in this book, and his name I know not.

note: *I know not Yahuah (the Lord) whom you have declared, neither will I send his people* (Jasher 79:46) — almost word for word with Exodus 5:2; ignorance of the Name welded to refusal to release the people.

quotes.quote: I know not Yahuah (the Lord) whom you have declared, neither will I send his people
quotes.live_here: And Pharaoh turned to Moses and Aaron and said to them, I know not Yahuah (the Lord) whom you have declared, neither will I send his people.

note: *that we may take a journey for three days in the wilderness, and there may sacrifice to him* (Jasher 79:48) — unfolds *that they may hold a feast unto me* (Exodus 5:1): the Exodus is FOR worship, the appointed sacrifice owed since Egypt.

quotes.quote: that we may take a journey for three days in the wilderness, and there may sacrifice to him
quotes.live_here: Now therefore send us, that we may take a journey for three days in the wilderness, and there may sacrifice to him, for from the days of our going down to Egypt, he has not taken from our hands either burnt offering, oblation or sacrifice, and if you will not send us, his anger will be kindled against you, and he will smite Egypt either with the plague or with the sword.

note: *he ordered the labor upon Israel to be more severe than it was yesterday and before* (Jasher 79:52) — the restored witness names the same cruelty: deliverance announced, bondage intensified.

quotes.quote: he ordered the labor upon Israel to be more severe than it was yesterday and before
quotes.live_here: And he drove them from him, and he ordered the labor upon Israel to be more severe than it was yesterday and before.

note: *Why have you ill treated your people? for since I came to speak to Pharaoh... he has exceedingly ill used the children of Israel* (Jasher 79:54) — the restored witness gives Moses' grief in the same breath as Exodus 5:23.

quotes.quote: Why have you ill treated your people? for since I came to speak to Pharaoh... he has exceedingly ill used the children of Israel
quotes.live_here: And Moses returned to Yahuah (the Lord) and said, Why have you ill treated your people? for since I came to speak to Pharaoh what you did send me for, he has exceedingly ill used the children of Israel.

note: *Send away the woman and her children that they may go to her father's house... and Moses... did so* (Jasher 79:17) — Jasher fills the gap behind *after he had sent her back* (Exodus 18:2).

quotes.quote: Send away the woman and her children that they may go to her father's house... and Moses... did so
quotes.live_here: And Aaron said to Moses, Send away the woman and her children that they may go to her father’s house, and Moses hearkened to the words of Aaron, and did so.

note: *Zipporah returned with her children... to the house of Reuel, and remained there until... Yahuah... brought them forth from Egypt* (Jasher 79:18) — the home Jethro travels from in *came... unto Moses into the wilderness* (Exodus 18:5).

quotes.quote: Zipporah returned with her children... to the house of Reuel, and remained there until... Yahuah... brought them forth from Egypt
quotes.live_here: And Zipporah returned with her children, and they went to the house of Reuel, and remained there until the time arrived when Yahuah (the Lord) had visited his people, and brought them forth from Egypt from the hand at Pharaoh.

note: Jasher 81:4 — *Yahuah brought forth the children of Israel from Egypt with a strong hand* — the going-up from Egypt, gathered into the Son called out of Egypt.

quotes.quote: Yahuah brought forth the children of Israel from Egypt with a strong hand
quotes.live_here: And at the end of two hundred and ten years, Yahuah (the Lord) brought forth the children of Israel from Egypt with a strong hand.

note: Jasher 88:61 — *Yahuah (the Lord) sent upon them hailstones from heaven, and more of them died by the hailstones*; the book Joshua 10:13 cites, agreeing.

quotes.quote: Yahuah (the Lord) sent upon them hailstones from heaven, and more of them died by the hailstones
quotes.live_here: And whilst they were fleeing, Yahuah (the Lord) sent upon them hailstones from heaven, and more of them died by the hailstones, than by the slaughter of the children of Israel.

note: Jasher 88:63 — the cited book records the very prayer: *Sun, stand you still upon Gibeon, and you moon in the valley of Ajalon*.

quotes.quote: Sun, stand you still upon Gibeon, and you moon in the valley of Ajalon
quotes.live_here: And when they were smiting, the day was declining toward evening, and Joshua said in the sight of all the people, Sun, stand you still upon Gibeon, and you moon in the valley of Ajalon, until the nation shall have revenged itself upon its enemies.

note: Jasher 88:64 — *the sun stood still in the midst of the heavens... and the moon also stood still*; the book Joshua 10:13 names, speaking.

quotes.quote: the sun stood still in the midst of the heavens... and the moon also stood still
quotes.live_here: And Yahuah (the Lord) hearkened to the voice of Joshua, and the sun stood still in the midst of the heavens, and it stood still six and thirty moments, and the moon also stood still and hastened not to go down a whole day.

note: Jasher 88:65 — *there was no day like that... that Yahuah (the Lord) hearkened to the voice of a man, for Yahuah (the Lord) fought for Israel*; word for word with 10:14.

quotes.quote: there was no day like that... that Yahuah (the Lord) hearkened to the voice of a man, for Yahuah (the Lord) fought for Israel
quotes.live_here: And there was no day like that, before it or after it, that Yahuah (the Lord) hearkened to the voice of a man, for Yahuah (the Lord) fought for Israel.
